subject: Clean shiny server install - pandoc eats server

messages.author: 9e67b6b495878d42
messages.subject: Clean shiny server install - pandoc eats server
parts: Here's a support thread that I started that seems to have puttered out.  To summarize, when loading the sample script at the root of my server (fresh install, both of OS & shiny), pandoc runs away with the CPU immediately, and eventually will consume all available RAM unless killed.  I'm posting here in hopes that more eyes will lead to a possible solution.
